- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.
- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):

- Coordination and sequencing:

  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:

- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

local default = {}
local hit_label = "projectile"

local function GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnCreated(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local ability = self:GetAbility()
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    self.parent              = self:GetParent() -- dummy
    self.owner               = self:GetCaster() -- hero
    self.ability             = self:GetAbility()

    self.projectile_name     = kv.projectile_name
    self.projectile_interval = kv.projectile_interval
    self.projectile_range    = kv.projectile_range

    self.projectile_sp_interval = kv.projectile_sp_interval
    self.projectile_sp_range    = kv.projectile_sp_range

    self.ability_sp          = kv.ability_sp
    self.modifier_sp         = kv.modifier_sp

    self.is_attack           = false

    self.attacker_override   = self.owner
    self.base_damage         = kv.projectile_base_damage or 0
    self.hit_label           = hit_label

    if self.projectile_name and self.projectile_name ~= "attack" then

    end

        local sp = self.parent:AddAbility(self.ability_sp)

        end

        --print("[Ability SP]", self.ability_sp, sp, sp:GetAbilityName())

            passive:SetActivated(true)
        end

        self.passive_sp = kv.passive_sp
        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_sp)
        if passive then
            if kv.passive_sp_level ~= 0 then
                passive:SetLevel(kv.passive_sp_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
        end

        "hero_fake_death",

end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(event_table)

    --DebugPrint("Receive Dead", event_table.entindex, self.owner:entindex())

        return
    end

    local is_dead = event_table.is_dead

    if is_dead == 1 then -- å‡æ­»çŠ¶æ€å¼€å§?
        -- åœæ­¢ OnIntervalThink è®¡æ—¶å™¨ï¼Œåœæ­¢è‡ªåŠ¨æ–½æ³•
        self:StartIntervalThink(-1)
        -- å¯é€‰ï¼šç¦ç”¨ Dummy Unit ä¸Šçš„æŠ€èƒ½ï¼Œç¡®ä¿å®‰å…¨
        if self.skill then
            self.skill:SetActivated(false)
        end
    elseif is_dead == 0 then -- å‡æ­»çŠ¶æ€ç»“æ?
        -- æ¢å¤æŠ€èƒ½æ¿€æ´»çŠ¶æ€?
        if self.skill then

        self:StartIntervalThink(self:GetFinalInterval())

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval()
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)

    local base = self.projectile_interval

    local pct = 1 + BpToFlat(s.ProjectileCooldown or 0)


    local final = base / pct

    if final < 0.05 then
        final = 0.05
    end

    --print("final interval", base, pct, final)

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalCastRange()
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)
    local final = self.projectile_range + (s.ProjectileRange or 0)

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(target)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.ability or self.ability:IsNull() then return end

    -- dummy æ°¸è¿œè´´åœ¨è‹±é›„è„šä¸‹
    self.parent:SetAbsOrigin(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
    self.parent:FaceTowards(target:GetAbsOrigin())

    local proj_speed = 900

    local info = {
        Target     = target,
        Source     = self.owner,
        Ability    = self.ability,
        EffectName = self.ability:GetAbilityKeyValues().ProjectileModel,
        iMoveSpeed = proj_speed,
        bDodgeable = true,
        bIsAttack  = false,
        ExtraData  = {
            owner_entindex = self.owner:entindex(),
            dummy_entindex = self.parent:entindex(),
            base_damage    = self.base_damage,
            hit_label      = self.hit_label,
            proj_speed     = proj_speed,

            spawn_time     = GameRules:GetGameTime(),
            max_time       = 2,
        }
    }

    local proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
    info.ExtraData.projectile_id = proj_id
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnIntervalThink()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if (not self.is_attack and not self.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return
    end

    --self.parent:SetAbsOrigin(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval()
    self:StartIntervalThink(interval)

    if self.behavior == "Self" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })

        -- local p1 = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
        --     "particles/units/heroes/hero_omniknight/omniknight_purification.vpcf",
        --     PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,
        --     self.owner
        -- )
        -- ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(p1)

        return
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------
    -- å¯»æ‰¾æ•Œäºº
    ----------------------------------------------------
    local origin = self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange()
    local forward = self.owner:GetForwardVector()
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        self.owner:GetTeamNumber(),
        origin,
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )

    local pos
    local enemy

    if #enemies == 0 then
        -- pos = origin + forward * range
        return
    end

    enemy = enemies[1]

    pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

    local dir = pos - origin
    dir.z = 0
    local minDist = range * 0.5
    local maxDist = range - 50
    local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

    local dist = dir:Length2D()
    if dist < 150 then
        pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
    end

    if dist > range then
        pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
    end

    --print("enemy", enemy:GetUnitName())

    if self.is_attack then
        self:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(enemy)
        return
    end

    self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
    self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)

    -- self.parent:CastAbilityOnPosition(pos, self.skill, -1)

    if self.behavior == "Position" then
        --print("cast position")

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif self.behavior == "Target" then
        --print("cast target")

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif self.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        --print("cast no target")

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end
end

            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp:Destroy()
        self.dummy_sp = nil
    end
end

function spawn_manager:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(fromIndex, startTime)
    local acc_time  = startTime or GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local next_wave = 0
    local next_boss = 0

    -- 从 fromIndex 之后的那一波开始（0 表示从第 1 波开始看）
    for i = fromIndex, 999 do
        local w = WavesKV[tostring(i)]
        if not w then break end

        local pre = tonumber(w["PreDelay"]) or 0
        local dur = tonumber(w["Duration"]) or 0
        local isB = (tostring(w["IsBossWave"] or "0") == "1")

        acc_time = acc_time + pre

        if (not isB) and next_wave == 0 then
            next_wave = acc_time
        end

        if isB and next_boss == 0 then
            next_boss = acc_time
        end

        -- 如果找到了普通波生成点，且已经确定了下一个 Boss 点（或之后没 Boss），则退出
        if next_wave > 0 and (next_boss > 0 or i > fromIndex + 5) then
            break
        end

        -- 累加持续时间，用于计算再下一波的起点
        acc_time = acc_time + dur
    end

    return next_wave, next_boss
end

function spawn_manager:GetAliveCount()
    local count = 0

    for key, value in pairs(self.active_monsters) do
        count = count + 1
    end

    return count
end

function spawn_manager:RegisterMonster(u, mod_ai, target_entid)
    if u then
        u.owner_id = self.pid
        if target_entid then
            u.target_entid = target_entid
        end
        entid = u:GetEntityIndex()
        self.active_monsters[entid] = mod_ai
    end
end

function spawn_manager:CreateRun(type, id, total)
    self.run_seq = self.run_seq + 1
    local rid = self.run_seq

    self.runs[rid] = {
        type           = type, -- "wave" / "boss" / "challenge"
        id             = id,
        alive          = total,
        monsters       = {},
        finished_time  = nil,
        time_completed = false,
    }

    return rid
end

function spawn_manager:OnRunCompleted(type, id)
    if type == "challenge" then
        self:GiveChallengeReward(id)
    elseif type == "boss" then
        self:GiveBossReward(id)
    elseif type == "wave" then
        self:GiveWaveReward(id)
    end
end

function spawn_manager:ParseBuffKV(kv)
    local result = {}
    if not kv then return result end

    for field, val in pairs(kv) do
        local num = tonumber(val)
        if num then
            result[field] = num
        end
    end

    return result
end

function spawn_manager:GetDifficultyBuff()
    local level  = GameRules.selectedDifficulty or 1
    local data   = DifficultyKV[tostring(level)]
    local result = {}
    if not data then return result end

    local factor = tonumber(data["DifficultyFactors"]) or 1
    if factor == 1 then return result end

    local field = {}
    for f in string.gmatch(data["AffectFields"] or "", "%S+") do
        table.insert(field, f)
    end

    for _, key in ipairs(field) do
        if factor then
            result[key] = factor
        end
    end

    for k, v in pairs(data) do
        local num = tonumber(v)
        if num and k ~= "DifficultyFactors" and k ~= "AffectFields" and MonsterStats.Calculate[k] then
            result[k] = num
        end
    end

    local tag = "difficulty_" .. tostring(level)

    return { buff = result, tag = tag }
end

function spawn_manager:SpawnGroup(monsters, points, opts)
    opts              = opts or {}
    local copies      = opts.copies_per_point or 1
    local buffKV      = opts.buff
    local maxAlive    = opts.max_alive
    local buffBuilder = opts.buff_builder
    local run_id      = opts.run_id

    if not monsters or not next(monsters) then return end
    if not points or #points == 0 then return end

    local buff             = self:ParseBuffKV(buffKV)
    local diffBuff         = self:GetDifficultyBuff()

    local fixedBuffs       = {}
    local fixedBuffIDs     = {}

    local diffBuffID       = diffBuff.tag
    fixedBuffs[diffBuffID] = diffBuff.buff
    table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, diffBuffID)

    for template, countStr in pairs(monsters) do
        --print("Spawning monster group:", template)

        local count = tonumber(countStr) or 0

        if count > 0 then
            if buffKV then
                local buffID       = opts.tag .. "_" .. template
                fixedBuffs[buffID] = buff
                table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, buffID)

                -- print("------[Buff]------")
                -- print("ID", buffID)
                -- DeepPrintTable(buff)
                -- print("------[Buff]-------")
            end


            local base_buff_kv = MonsterStatsKV[template]

            if base_buff_kv == nil then
                print("[spawn_manager] SpawnGroup: no MonsterStatsKV for template =", template)
                return
            end

            local unit_name = base_buff_kv.UnitName
            local base_buff = self:ParseBuffKV(base_buff_kv or {})
            local baseBuffID = "base_" .. template
            fixedBuffs[baseBuffID] = base_buff
            table.insert(fixedBuffIDs, baseBuffID)

            -- print("------[BaseBuff]------")
            -- print("ID", baseBuffID)
            -- DeepPrintTable(base_buff)
            -- print("------[BaseBuff]-------")

            -- print("------[DifficultyBuff]------")
            -- print("ID", diffBuffID)
            -- DeepPrintTable(diffBuff)
            -- print("------[DifficultyBuff]-------")

            local allBuffIDs = NewTable(fixedBuffIDs)
            local allBuffDataList = {}

            if buffBuilder then
                local extraKV = buffBuilder(template)
                if extraKV then
                    local extraBuff = self:ParseBuffKV(extraKV)
                    if next(extraBuff) then
                        local dynamicBuffID = opts.tag .. "_" .. template
                        fixedBuffs[dynamicBuffID] = extraBuff
                        table.insert(allBuffIDs, dynamicBuffID)

                        -- print("------[ExtraBuff]------")
                        -- print("ID", dynamicBuffID)
                        -- DeepPrintTable(extraBuff)
                        -- print("------[ExtraBuff]-------")
                    end
                end
            end

            local buffTag = MonsterStats:ComputeFinalCacheKey(allBuffIDs)
            --print("Computed Buff Tag for", template, "UnitName", unit_name, ":", buffTag)

            for _, point in ipairs(points) do
                local pos = point:GetAbsOrigin()
                local ent_id = point:GetEntityIndex()
                local target_entid = GameState.walls[self.pid][ent_id]

                -- print("[Spwan]", point, pos, ent_id, self.pid, target_entid)

                for _ = 1, copies do
                    for i = 1, count do
                        if maxAlive and run_id then
                            if self:GetRunAliveCount(run_id) >= maxAlive then
                                return
                            end
                        end

                        local unit = monster_system:Spawn(unit_name, pos, buffTag)

                        if unit then
                            if not MonsterStats:Get(buffTag) then
                                for _, id in ipairs(allBuffIDs) do
                                    local buffData = fixedBuffs[id]
                                    if buffData then
                                        table.insert(allBuffDataList, buffData)
                                    end
                                end

                                monster_system:StoreStat(allBuffDataList, unit_name, buffTag)
                            end

                            local mod_ai = monster_system:ApplyStat(unit)


                            self:RegisterMonster(unit, mod_ai, target_entid)

                            if opts.items then
                                for index, value in ipairs(opts.items) do
                                    monster_system:AddItem(unit, value, self.pid)
                                end
                            end

                            if run_id then
                                local run = self.runs[run_id]
                                if run and run.monsters then
                                    unit._run_id = run_id
                                    table.insert(self.runs[run_id].monsters, unit)
                                else
                                    unit._run_id = nil
                                end
                            end

                            -- PrintStat(unit)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 启动下一波
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:StartNextWave(firstWave)
    if self.current_wave_timers then
        for _, timerId in ipairs(self.current_wave_timers) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(timerId)
        end
    end

    self.current_wave_timers  = {}

    self.current_wave_index   = self.current_wave_index + 1
    local wave_index_snapshot = self.current_wave_index

    local waveKey             = tostring(self.current_wave_index)
    local waveData            = WavesKV[waveKey]
    if not waveData then
        print("[Wave] StartNextWave: no wave data for key =", waveKey)
        EndCustomGame("胜利")
        return
    end

    local isBoss = tostring(waveData["IsBossWave"] or "0") == "1"
    print(string.format("[Wave] StartNextWave index=%s, isBoss=%s, firstWave=%s",
        waveKey, tostring(isBoss), tostring(firstWave)))

    local pre      = tonumber(waveData["PreDelay"]) or 0
    local duration = tonumber(waveData["Duration"]) or 0
    if firstWave then pre = 0 end

    self.wave_active                = false
    self.wave_state.current_wave    = self.current_wave_display
    self.wave_state.wave_active     = false

    local now                       = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    self.wave_state.wave_start_time = now + pre
    self.wave_state.wave_end_time   = now + pre + duration

    local next_w, next_b            = self:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(self.current_wave_index, now)
    self.wave_state.next_wave_time  = next_w
    self.wave_state.next_boss_time  = next_b
    self:SyncWaveState()

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 波次正式开始
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    --self:StartPermanentSpawner()

    local pre_timer_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(pre, function()
        if not isBoss then
            self.current_wave_display = self.current_wave_display + 1
        end

        self.wave_active = true
        self.wave_state.wave_active = true
        self.wave_state.current_wave = self.current_wave_display

        local nw, nb = self:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(self.current_wave_index + 1, self.wave_state.wave_end_time)
        self.wave_state.next_wave_time = nw
        self.wave_state.next_boss_time = nb

        self:SyncWaveState()

        local monstersKV       = waveData["Monsters"] or {}
        local spawnPointsKV    = waveData["SpawnPoints"] or {}

        local orderedTemplates =
            BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, waveData)

        local maxAlive         = tonumber(waveData["MaxAlive"]) or 99999

        local monstersOrdered  = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
            local countStr = monstersKV[name]
            table.insert(monstersOrdered, {
                template = name,
                count    = tonumber(countStr) or 0
            })
        end

        local perTemplatePoints = BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)

        local rawBuff = waveData["Buff"] or {}
        local buffArr = {}
        for field, str in pairs(rawBuff) do
            buffArr[field] = ParseArray(str)
        end

        local intervalArr = ParseArray(waveData["SpawnInterval"])
        if #intervalArr == 0 then intervalArr[1] = 1 end

        local function BuildWaveBuff(template)
            local idx = 1
            for i, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
                if d.template == template then
                    idx = i
                    break
                end
            end

            local b = {}
            for k, arr in pairs(buffArr) do
                b[k] = arr[idx] or arr[#arr] or 0
            end

            return self:ParseBuffKV(b)
        end

        local total = 0
        for _, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
            local template = d.template
            local count    = d.count
            local pts      = perTemplatePoints[template] or {}
            total          = total + count * #pts
        end

        local run_type = isBoss and "boss" or "wave"
        local rid = self:CreateRun(run_type, self.current_wave_index, total)

        local tag_index = isBoss and self.current_wave_index or self.current_wave_display
        local wave_tag = string.format("%s_%s", run_type, tostring(tag_index))

        for i, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
            local template    = d.template
            local count       = d.count
            local interval    = intervalArr[i] or intervalArr[#intervalArr] or 1

            local subMonsters = {
                [template] = tostring(count)
            }

            local items
            if waveData.Item then
                local item_cfg = waveData.Item[template]
                if item_cfg then
                    items = ParseStringArray(item_cfg)
                end

                -- print("[Monster Item]",template, waveData, waveData.Item, waveData.Item[template], items)
                -- DeepPrintTable(items)
            end

            local timer_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(0, function()
                if interval < 0 then
                    self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint(subMonsters, perTemplatePoints[template], {
                        max_alive    = maxAlive,
                        buff_builder = BuildWaveBuff,
                        run_id       = rid,
                        tag          = wave_tag,
                        items        = items,
                    })
                else
                    local loop_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(function()
                        if not self.wave_active then return nil end
                        if maxAlive
                            and rid
                            and self:GetRunAliveCount(rid) >= maxAlive then
                            return interval
                        end

                        -- print("Spawning wave monsters:", template)

                        self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint(subMonsters, perTemplatePoints[template], {
                            max_alive    = maxAlive,
                            buff_builder = BuildWaveBuff,
                            run_id       = rid,
                            tag          = wave_tag,
                            items        = items,
                        })

                        return interval
                    end)

                    table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, loop_id)

                    return nil
                end
            end)

            table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, timer_id)
        end
    end)

    table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, pre_timer_id)

    self:CreateManagedTimer(pre + duration, function()
        local rid = nil
        for id, run in pairs(self.runs) do
            if run.id == wave_index_snapshot then
                rid = id
                break
            end
        end

        if rid then
            local run = self.runs[rid]
            run.time_completed = true

            if run.type == "wave" and run.alive <= 0 and not run.reward_given then
                run.reward_given = true
                self:OnRunCompleted("wave", run.id)
            end

            self.runs[rid] = nil
        end

        self:StartNextWave(false)
    end)
end

function spawn_manager:TriggerChallenge(id)
    local idx = tonumber(id) or id

    if idx == 1 then
        return
    end

    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(idx)]
    if not data then
        print("[Challenge] TriggerChallenge: no data for id =", idx)
        return
    end
    self.challenge_state[idx] = self.challenge_state[idx] or { count = 0, nextAvailable = 0 }
    local st                  = self.challenge_state[idx]
    local now                 = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    local cd                  = tonumber(data["Cooldown"]) or 30
    if now < st.nextAvailable then
        print("[Challenge] id", idx, "still on cd, left =", st.nextAvailable - now)
        return
    end

    -- 递增难度次数
    st.count = st.count + 1

    -- 难度因子
    local factors = {}
    for f in string.gmatch(tostring(data["DifficultyFactors"] or "1"), "%S+") do
        table.insert(factors, tonumber(f))
    end
    if #factors == 0 then table.insert(factors, 1) end

    local factor = factors[st.count] or factors[#factors]

    -- 字段
    local affected_fields = {}
    for f in string.gmatch(tostring(data["AffectFields"] or ""), "%S+") do
        table.insert(affected_fields, f)
    end

    -- 计算下一次冷却时间
    st.nextAvailable = now + cd

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("challenge_waves", tostring(idx), {
        cooldown = cd,
        next_cd  = st.nextAvailable,
        count    = st.count,
    })

    local function BuildChallengeBuff()
        local buff = {}
        for _, field_name in ipairs(affected_fields) do
            buff[field_name] = factor
        end

        return buff
    end

    print(string.format("[Challenge] Trigger id=%s, count=%d, factor=%.2f, cd=%d",
        tostring(idx), st.count, factor, cd))

    self:SpawnChallenge(idx, BuildChallengeBuff)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 挑战刷怪（使用 SpawnGroup + run）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:SpawnChallenge(id, buff_builder)
    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(id)]
    if not data then return end

    local monstersKV        = data["Monsters"] or {}
    local spawnPointsKV     = data["SpawnPoints"] or {}

    local orderedTemplates  =
        BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, data)
    local perTemplatePoints = BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)

    local total             = 0
    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
        local count = tonumber(monstersKV[template]) or 0
        local pts   = perTemplatePoints[template] or {}
        total       = total + count * #pts
    end

    local rid = self:CreateRun("challenge", id, total)

    local challenge_state = self.challenge_state[id]
    local count = challenge_state and challenge_state.count or 1
    local challenge_tag = string.format("challenge_%s_%d", tostring(id), count)

    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
        local count = tonumber(monstersKV[template]) or 0
        local pts   = perTemplatePoints[template]

        if count > 0 and pts and #pts > 0 then
            self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint({ [template] = tostring(count) }, pts, {
                copies_per_point = 1,
                buff_builder     = buff_builder,
                run_id           = rid,
                tag              = challenge_tag,
            })
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 挑战奖励
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:GiveChallengeReward(id)
    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(id)]
    if not data then return end

    local st = self.challenge_state[id]
    local count = st and st.count or 1

    local base = data["Reward"] or {}
    local reward = {}

    if base.gold and base.gold ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.gold)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["gold"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.exp and base.exp ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.exp)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["exp"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.shop1_item and base.shop1_item ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.shop1_item)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["shop1_item"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.shop2_item and base.shop2_item ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.shop2_item)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["shop2_item"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    reward["special_selection"] = tonumber(base.special_selection) or 0

    self:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
end

function spawn_manager:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
    reward                  = reward or {}
    local gold              = tonumber(reward["gold"]) or 0
    local exp               = tonumber(reward["exp"]) or 0
    local shop1_item        = reward["shop1_item"] or 0
    local shop2_item        = reward["shop2_item"] or 0
    local special_selection = reward["special_selection"] or 0
    local player            = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)

    if not player then return end

    if gold > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(self.pid, "gold", gold)
    end

    local unit = player:GetAssignedHero()

    if unit and exp > 0 then
        unit:AddExperience(exp, DOTA_ModifyXP_Unspecified, false, true)
    end

    if unit and shop1_item ~= 0 then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid]:AddItemRandomly(unit, shop1_item)
    end

    if unit and shop2_item ~= 0 then
        Shop2Manager:AddAbilityRandomly(unit, shop2_item)
    end

    if unit and special_selection == 1 then
        SelectionSpecial:StartSelection(self.pid)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 统一死亡监听（Boss / Wave / Challenge）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:OnUnitKilled(unit)
    local pid = unit.owner_id
    local entid = unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if pid and entid then
        SpawnManagers[pid].active_monsters[entid] = nil
    end

    local rid = unit._run_id
    if not rid then return end

    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return end

    run.alive = run.alive - 1

    -- Wave 是时间 + 怪物清空 两者都满足才完成
    if run.type == "wave" then
        if run.time_completed and run.alive <= 0 then
            self:OnRunCompleted("wave", run.id)
            self.runs[rid] = nil
        end
        return
    end

    -- Boss / Challenge ：怪全死即完成
    if run.alive <= 0 then
        -- print("Run", run.type, run.alive)
        self:OnRunCompleted(run.type, run.id)
        self.runs[rid] = nil
    end
end

function EndCustomGame(result)

    GameState.game_over_flag = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        ClearAllGroundItems()

        for pid, mgr in pairs(SpawnManagers) do

function ClearAllGroundItems()
    local drops = Entities:FindAllByClassname("dota_item_drop")

    for _, drop in pairs(drops) do
        if not drop:IsNull() then
            local item = drop:GetContainedItem()
            if item and not item:IsNull() then
                item:RemoveSelf()
            end
            drop:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end
end

function ResetAllHeroes()
    local heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes()
    if not heroes then
        return
    end

    print("heros", #heroes)

    for _, hero in ipairs(heroes) do
        if hero:IsRealHero() and not hero:IsTempestDouble() and not hero:IsClone() then
            local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()
            local heroName = hero:GetUnitName()

            Shop1Managers[pid]:DestroyAllItems(hero)

            for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do
                local ability = hero:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
                if ability then
                    hero:RemoveAbilityByHandle(ability)
                end
            end

            local modifiers = hero:FindAllModifiers()
            for _, mod in pairs(modifiers) do
                mod:Destroy()
            end

            hero:Stop()

            -- 2. 关闭自动攻击
            hero:SetIdleAcquire(false)
            hero:SetAcquisitionRange(0)

            -- 3. 清空当前攻击目标
            hero:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)

            -- 4. 直接 Kill（非常重要）
            hero:ForceKill(false)

            local newHero = PlayerResource:ReplaceHeroWith(pid, heroName, 0, 0)

            Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
                if newHero and not newHero:IsNull() then
                    local spawn = PlayerSpawnPoint[pid]
                    if spawn then
                        local pos = spawn:GetOrigin()
                        FindClearSpaceForUnit(newHero, pos, true)
                        print("Respawn", pos)
                        newHero:SetOrigin(pos)
                    end

                    newHero:Stop()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

--[[
  Hero spawned for the first time. It can happen if the player's hero is replaced with a new hero for any reason.
  This can be used for initializing heroes, such as adding levels, changing the starting gold, removing/adding abilities, adding physics, etc.
  This happens to bot and custom created heroes as well.
  The hero parameter is the hero entity that just spawned.

]]
function barebones:OnHeroInGame(hero)
	-- Innate abilities like Earth Spirit Stone Remnant (abilities that a hero needs to have auto-leveled up at the start of the game)
	-- Take a look at this guide: https://moddota.com/abilities/creating-innate-abilities
	local innate_abilities = {
		"innate_ability1",
		"innate_ability2"
	}

	-- Cycle through any innate abilities found, then set their level to 1
	for i = 1, #innate_abilities do
		local current_ability = hero:FindAbilityByName(innate_abilities[i])
		if current_ability then
			current_ability:SetLevel(1)
		end
	end

	Timers:CreateTimer(0.5, function()
		local playerID = hero:GetPlayerID() -- never nil (-1 by default), needs delay 1 or more frames

		if PlayerResource:IsFakeClient(playerID) then
			-- This is happening only for bots
			DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Bot hero " .. hero:GetUnitName() .. " (re)spawned in the game.")
			-- Set starting gold for bots
			hero:SetGold(NORMAL_START_GOLD, false)
		else
			DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame running for a non-bot player!")
			if not PlayerResource.PlayerData[playerID] and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(playerID) then
				PlayerResource:InitPlayerDataForID(playerID)
			end
			if hero:IsClone() then
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Spawned hero is a Meepo Clone")
				return
			elseif hero:IsTempestDouble() then
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Spawned hero is a Tempest Double")
				return
			elseif IsMonkeyKingCloneCustom(hero) then
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Spawned hero is a Monkey King soldier or invalid entity")
				return
			elseif hero:IsSpiritBearCustom() then
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Spawned hero is a Spirit Bear")
				return
			end
			-- Set some hero stuff on first spawn or on every spawn (custom or not)
			if PlayerResource.PlayerData[playerID].already_set_hero == true then
				-- This is happening only when players create new heroes or replace them
			else
				local hero_name = hero:GetUnitName()
				-- This is happening for players when their primary hero spawns for the first time
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Hero " ..
					hero_name .. " spawned in the game for the first time for the player with ID: " .. playerID)

				barebones:InitCustomHero(playerID, hero, hero_name)

				-- Make heroes briefly visible on spawn (to prevent bad fog of war interactions)
				hero:MakeVisibleToTeam(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS, 0.5)
				hero:MakeVisibleToTeam(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS, 0.5)

				-- Set the starting gold for the player's hero
				-- Use 'PlayerResource:ModifyGold(playerID, NORMAL_START_GOLD-600, false, 0)' if GameRules:SetStartingGold breaks again
				-- If the NORMAL_START_GOLD is less than 600, disable Strategy Time and use 'hero:SetGold(NORMAL_START_GOLD, false)' instead
				-- Why? Because OnHeroInGame is triggering during PreGame (after Strategy Time) and players can buy items during Strategy Time (starting gold will remain default 600)

				if ADDITIONAL_GPM then
					hero:AddNewModifier(hero, nil, "modifier_custom_passive_gold", {})
				end

				-- Create an item and add it to the player's hero, effectively ensuring they start with the item
				if ADD_ITEM_TO_HERO_ON_SPAWN then
					local item = CreateItem("item_example_item", hero, hero)
					hero:AddItem(item)
				end

				-- Make sure that stuff above will not happen again for the player if some other hero spawns
				-- for him for the first time during the game
				PlayerResource.PlayerData[playerID].already_set_hero = true
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Hero " ..
					hero:GetUnitName() .. " set for the player with ID: " .. playerID)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- A player leveled up
function barebones:OnPlayerLevelUp(keys)
	DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnPlayerLevelUp event")
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local level = keys.level
	local playerID = keys.player_id or keys.PlayerID

	if keys.hero_entindex then
		hero = EntIndexToHScript(keys.hero_entindex)
	else
		hero = PlayerResource:GetBarebonesAssignedHero(playerID)
	end

	if hero then
		local hero_name = hero:GetUnitName()

		-- Update hero gold bounty when a hero gains a level
		if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then
			local hero_level = hero:GetLevel() or level
			local hero_streak = hero:GetStreak()

			local gold_bounty
			if hero_streak > 2 then
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL +
					(hero_streak - 2) * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_STREAK
			else
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL
			end

			hero:SetMinimumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
			hero:SetMaximumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
		end

		--print("Levelup KV", GrowthKV, "Name", hero_name, "Stats", GrowthKV[hero_name])

		local growth = PlayerStats:GetGrowth(playerID)

		if growth then
			for k, v in pairs(growth) do
				local attrs = {}

				for key, val in pairs(v) do
					attrs[key] = tonumber(val) or val
				end

				--print("[Levelup]", hero_name, "gained level", level, "with growth:", k)
				--DeepPrintTable(attrs)

				StatsManager:AddSource(playerID, "levelup", attrs, { type = "hero_growth" })
			end
		end

		-- Example how to add an extra skill point when a hero levels up
		--[[
		local levels_without_ability_point = {17, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24}	-- on this levels you should get a skill point (edit this if needed)
		for i = 1, #levels_without_ability_point do
			if level == levels_without_ability_point[i] then
				local unspent_ability_points = hero:GetAbilityPoints()
				hero:SetAbilityPoints(unspent_ability_points + 1)
			end
		end
		]]

		-- If you want to remove skill points when a hero levels up then uncomment the following line:
		-- hero:SetAbilityPoints(0)
	end
end

-- An entity died (an entity killed an entity)
function barebones:OnEntityKilled(keys)
	--DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] An entity was killed.")
	--PrintTable(keys)

	-- Indexes:
	local killed_entity_index = keys.entindex_killed
	local attacker_entity_index = keys.entindex_attacker
	local inflictor_index = keys.entindex_inflictor -- it can be nil if not killed by an item/ability

	-- Find the entity that was killed
	local killed_unit
	if killed_entity_index then
		killed_unit = EntIndexToHScript(killed_entity_index)
	end

	-- Find the entity (killer) that killed the entity mentioned above
	local killer_unit
	if attacker_entity_index then
		killer_unit = EntIndexToHScript(attacker_entity_index)
	end

	if killed_unit == nil or killed_unit.__is_evolving or killer_unit == nil then
		-- Don't continue if killer or killed entity doesn't exist
		return
	end

	-- Find the ability/item used to kill, or nil if not killed by an item/ability
	local killing_ability
	if inflictor_index then
		killing_ability = EntIndexToHScript(inflictor_index)
	end

	local is_monster = killed_unit:GetTeamNumber() == DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS

	if not killer_unit:IsRealHero()
		and killed_unit.last_real_attacker and not killed_unit.last_real_attacker:IsNull() and killed_unit.last_real_attacker:IsRealHero() then
		killer_unit = killed_unit.last_real_attacker
	end

	if is_monster and not GameRules.clearing_monsters then
		local pid = killed_unit.owner_id
		local mgr = pid and SpawnManagers[pid]

		if mgr then
			mgr:OnUnitKilled(killed_unit)
		end

		if killer_unit:IsRealHero() then
			reward_system:OnKill(killer_unit, killed_unit)
		end
	end

	-- For Meepo clones, find the original
	if killed_unit:IsClone() then
		if killed_unit.GetCloneSource and killed_unit:GetCloneSource() then
			killed_unit = killed_unit:GetCloneSource()
		end
	end

	-- Killed Unit is a hero (not an illusion) and he is not reincarnating
	if killed_unit:IsRealHero() and not killed_unit:IsTempestDouble() and not killed_unit:IsReincarnating() and not killed_unit:IsSpiritBearCustom() then
		-- Hero gold bounty update for the killer
		if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then
			if killer_unit:IsRealHero() and not killer_unit:IsSpiritBearCustom() and not killer_unit:IsTempestDouble() and not killer_unit:IsClone() and not IsMonkeyKingCloneCustom(killer_unit) then
				-- Get his killing streak
				local hero_streak = killer_unit:GetStreak()
				-- Get his level
				local hero_level = killer_unit:GetLevel()
				-- Adjust Gold bounty
				local gold_bounty
				if hero_streak > 2 then
					gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL +
						(hero_streak - 2) * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_STREAK
				else
					gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL
				end

				killer_unit:SetMinimumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
				killer_unit:SetMaximumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
			end
		end

		-- Hero Respawn time configuration
		if ENABLE_HERO_RESPAWN then
			local killed_unit_level = killed_unit:GetLevel()

			-- Calculating respawn time without buyback penalty
			local respawn_time = 1
			if USE_CUSTOM_RESPAWN_TIMES then
				-- Get respawn time from the table that we defined
				respawn_time = CUSTOM_RESPAWN_TIME[killed_unit_level]
			else
				-- Get dota default respawn time
				respawn_time = killed_unit:GetRespawnTime()
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnEntityKilled - Default respawn time for " ..
					killed_unit:GetUnitName() .. " is " .. respawn_time .. " seconds.")
			end

			-- Fixing respawn time after level 30, this is usually bugged in custom games if default respawn times are used -> respawn time are either too long or too short. We fix that.
			local respawn_time_after_30 = 100 + (killed_unit_level - 30) * 5
			if killed_unit_level > 30 and respawn_time ~= respawn_time_after_30 and not USE_CUSTOM_RESPAWN_TIMES then
				respawn_time = respawn_time_after_30
			end

			-- Old Bloodstone respawn reduction (this example doesn't check items in backpack because bloodstone cannot go in backpack)
			-- for i = DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_1, DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_6 do
			-- local item = killed_unit:GetItemInSlot(i)
			-- if item then
			-- if item:GetName() == "item_bloodstone" then
			-- local current_charges = item:GetCurrentCharges()
			-- local charges_before_death = math.ceil(current_charges*1.5)
			-- local reduction_per_charge = item:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("respawn_time_reduction", item:GetLevel() - 1)
			-- local respawn_reduction = charges_before_death*reduction_per_charge
			-- respawn_time = math.max(1, respawn_time-respawn_reduction)
			-- break -- break 'for' loop, to prevent multiple bloodstones granting respawn reduction
			-- end
			-- end
			-- end

			-- Old Reaper's Scythe respawn time increase
			-- if killing_ability then
			-- if killing_ability:GetAbilityName() == "necrolyte_reapers_scythe" then
			-- DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnEntityKilled - A hero was killed by a Necro Reaper's Scythe. Increasing respawn time!")
			-- local respawn_extra_time = killing_ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("respawn_constant", killing_ability:GetLevel() - 1)
			-- respawn_time = respawn_time + respawn_extra_time
			-- end
			-- end

			-- Killer is a neutral creep
			if killer_unit:IsNeutralUnitType() then
				-- If a hero is killed by a neutral creep, respawn time can be modified here
			end

			-- Capping Respawn Time (MAX respawn time)
			if respawn_time > MAX_RESPAWN_TIME then
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnEntityKilled - Reducing respawn time of " ..
					killed_unit:GetUnitName() .. " because it was too long.")
				respawn_time = MAX_RESPAWN_TIME
			end

			-- If hero is actually reincarnating don't change his respawn time:
			if not killed_unit:IsReincarnating() then
				killed_unit:SetTimeUntilRespawn(respawn_time)
			end
		end

		-- Hero Buyback Cooldown
		if CUSTOM_BUYBACK_COOLDOWN_ENABLED then
			PlayerResource:SetCustomBuybackCooldown(killed_unit:GetPlayerID(), CUSTOM_BUYBACK_COOLDOWN_TIME)
		end

		-- Hero Buyback Gold Cost, you can replace BUYBACK_FIXED_GOLD_COST with your formula
		if CUSTOM_BUYBACK_COST_ENABLED then
			PlayerResource:SetCustomBuybackCost(killed_unit:GetPlayerID(), BUYBACK_FIXED_GOLD_COST)
		end

		-- Killer is not a real hero but it killed a hero; IsFountain() is custom-made, can be found in 'util.lua'
		if killer_unit:IsTower() or killer_unit:IsCreep() or killer_unit:IsFountain() then
			-- Put stuff here that you want to happen if a hero is killed by a creep, tower or fountain.
		end

		-- When team hero kill limit is reached declare the winner
		if END_GAME_ON_KILLS and GetTeamHeroKills(killer_unit:GetTeam()) >= KILLS_TO_END_GAME_FOR_TEAM then
			GameRules:SetGameWinner(killer_unit:GetTeam())
		end

		-- Setting top bar values
		if SHOW_KILLS_ON_TOPBAR then
			local gamemode = GameRules:GetGameModeEntity()
			--gamemode:SetTopBarTeamValue(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS, GetTeamHeroKills(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS))   -- Doesn't work since Diretide 2020
			--gamemode:SetTopBarTeamValue(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS, GetTeamHeroKills(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)) -- Doesn't work since Diretide 2020
			gamemode:SetCustomRadiantScore(GetTeamHeroKills(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS))
			gamemode:SetCustomDireScore(GetTeamHeroKills(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS))
		end

		print("[GameEnd]", GameState.game_start)
		if GameState.game_start then
			EndCustomGame("å¤±è´¥")
		end
		-- barebones:FakeDeath(killed_unit)
	end

	-- Ancient destruction detection (if the map doesn't have ancients with these names, this will never happen)
	if killed_unit:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_badguys_fort" then
		GameRules:SetGameWinner(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
		GameRules:SetCustomVictoryMessage("#dota_post_game_radiant_victory")
		GameRules:SetCustomVictoryMessageDuration(POST_GAME_TIME)
	elseif killed_unit:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_goodguys_fort" then
		GameRules:SetGameWinner(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS)
		GameRules:SetCustomVictoryMessage("#dota_post_game_dire_victory")
		GameRules:SetCustomVictoryMessageDuration(POST_GAME_TIME)
	end

	-- Remove dead non-hero units from selection -> fixing bugged ability/cast bar
	if killed_unit:IsIllusion() or (killed_unit:IsControllableByAnyPlayer() and not killed_unit:IsRealHero() and not killed_unit:IsCourier() and not killed_unit:IsClone() and not killed_unit:IsTempestDouble()) then
		local player = killed_unit:GetPlayerOwner()
		local playerID
		if not player then
			playerID = killed_unit:GetPlayerOwnerID()
		else
			playerID = player:GetPlayerID()
		end

		if Selection then
			-- Without Selection library this will return an error
			PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, killed_unit)
		end
	end
end

function damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    local is_monster = attacker:GetTeamNumber() == DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS

    if is_monster then
        return Monster_ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    end

    local pid = attacker.GetPlayerID and attacker:GetPlayerID() or -1
    local s = PlayerStats:GetDisplay(pid)

    if not s or not victim or victim:IsNull() then return keys.damage end

    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 获取标签（attack/skill/projectile）
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    local label                = victim.hit_label or "attack"
    local pure_pct             = victim.pure_percent or 0
    local additional_lifesteal = victim.lifesteal

    victim.hit_label           = nil

    local source_damage        = 0
    local atk                  = s.game_final.Attack
    local final_damage         = s.game_final.FinalDamagePct
    local base                 = victim.base_damage or 0

    if label == "attack" then
        -- 普攻：（攻击力 + 普攻增伤）* 普攻增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.AttackDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.AttackDamagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat) * pct * final_damage
    elseif label == "projectile" then
        -- 弹幕：（攻击力 + 弹幕增伤 + 弹幕固伤）* 全弹幕增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.ProjectileDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.ProjectileDamagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat + base) * pct * final_damage

        --DebugPrint("Label  ", label, "  base  ", base, "  atk  ", atk, "  flat  ", flat, "  pct  ", pct, "  source  ", source_damage )
    elseif label == "skill" then
        -- 技能：（攻击力 + 技能固伤）* 技能增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.SkillDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.SkillDmagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat + base) * pct * final_damage
        print("[Skill Damage]", atk, flat, pct, source_damage)
    end

    if source_damage < 0 then
        source_damage = 0
    end

    local crit
    if label ~= "skill" then
        pct = math.floor(BpToFlat(s.game_final.CritChangePct))
        pct = math.max(0, math.min(pct, 100))

        crit = RollPseudoRandomPercentage(pct, DOTA_PSEUDO_RANDOM_CUSTOM_GENERIC, attacker)
        if crit then
            local flat = s.game_final.CritFlat or 0
            local mul = BpToRatio(s.game_final.CritMulPct or 0)
            source_damage = (source_damage + flat) * mul
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 纯粹攻击
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local pure_damage = source_damage * pure_pct
    local after       = source_damage - pure_damage
    -- print("[Damage Calc]", source_damage, pure_damage, after)

    local flat        = s.game_final.PureAttackFlat or 0
    local pct         = s.game_final.PureAttackPct or 0
    pure_damage       = (pure_damage + flat) * pct

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 护甲 / 魔抗计算
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    if label == "skill" then
        after = damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, after, s)
    else
        after = damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, after, s)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 吸血
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local lifesteal_pct = s.game_final.LifeSteal or 0
    if lifesteal_pct > 0 then
        attacker:Heal(lifesteal_pct, nil)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 伤害金币
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    reward_system:OnDamage(attacker, victim)

    if pure_pct > 0 then
        print("[Damage]", after, pure_damage, pure_pct)
    end

    local final = after + pure_damage

    if additional_lifesteal and additional_lifesteal > 0 then
        local heal = final * additional_lifesteal
        if heal > 0 then
            -- print("[additional_lifesteal]", additional_lifesteal, heal)
            attacker:Heal(heal, nil)
        end
    end



    if final > 0 then
        if crit then
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_CRITICAL, victim, final, nil)
        else
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_DAMAGE, victim, final, nil)
        end
    end

    return final
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：物理减伤（自带护甲穿透）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, base_phys_damage, atk_stats)
    --SafePrintEntity(victim)

    if base_phys_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local armor = victim:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false) or 0

    -- 护甲穿透（攻击方）
    local pierce = 0
    if atk_stats then
        pierce = atk_stats.game_final.ArmorPierce or 0
    end

    local armor_eff = armor - pierce

    -- Dota 物理减伤公式：0.06 * armor / (1 + 0.06 * armor)
    local reduction = 0
    if armor_eff >= 0 then
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 + 0.06 * armor_eff)
    else
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 - 0.06 * armor_eff) -- 负护甲增伤
    end

    local after = base_phys_damage * (1 - reduction)
    return after
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：魔法减伤（带自定义魔抗）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, base_mag_damage, atk_stats)
    if base_mag_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local resist = victim:Script_GetMagicalArmorValue(false, nil) or 0

    if resist > 0.95 then resist = 0.95 end
    if resist < -0.99 then resist = -0.99 end

    local after = base_mag_damage * (1 - resist)
    return after
end

    if not IsServer() then return end

    local itemAbility = self:GetAbility()
    self.ability_name = kv.ability_name
    self.dummy        = EntIndexToHScript(kv.dummy_index)
    self.level        = kv.level or 1
    self.pure_percent = kv.pure_percent or 0
    self.skill_base_damage = kv.skill_base_damage

    -- print("[Cast Listener Create]", self.ability_name, self.dummy:GetUnitName(), self.level)

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        local ab = self.dummy:FindAbilityByName(self.ability_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = self.dummy:AddAbility(self.ability_name)
        end

        if ab then
            ab:SetLevel(self.level)
            ab:SetActivated(true)
        end

        self.mod = self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, itemAbility, "modifier_dummy_cast", {
            ability_name = self.ability_name,
            pure_percent = self.pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:OnAbilityFullyCast(keys)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not keys or not keys.ability then return end

    -- print("[Cast Listener]", keys.ability, self:GetAbility(), self.dummy:GetUnitName(), self.mod:GetName())

    local ab = self:GetAbility()
    if keys.ability ~= ab then
        return
    end

    local target_index = ab.__last_target_index
    local pos = ab.__last_pos

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() and self.mod and not self.mod:IsNull() then
        self.mod:Cast(target_index, pos)
        ab.__last_target_index = nil
        ab.__last_pos = nil
    end
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_cast")
        self.dummy:RemoveAbility(self.ability_name)
        self.dummy = nil
        self.mod = nil
    end
end

function projectile_base:OnProjectileThink_ExtraData(pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not data then return end

    if data.spawn_time and data.max_time then
        if GameRules:GetGameTime() - data.spawn_time >= data.max_time then
            ProjectileManager:DestroyTrackingProjectile(data.projectile_id or -1)
            return
        end
    end

    -- 璁板綍鍓嶄竴甯т綅缃?
    if not data.prev_x then
        data.prev_x = pos.x
        data.prev_y = pos.y
        data.prev_z = pos.z
        return
    end

    -- 鐩爣姝讳骸 鈫?璁╂姇灏勭墿缁х画鎸夊師鏉ョ殑鏂瑰悜椋?
    local target = EntIndexToHScript(data.target_entindex or -1)
    if not target or target:IsNull() or not target:IsAlive() then
        local last = Vector(data.prev_x, data.prev_y, data.prev_z)
        local dir = (pos - last):Normalized()

        -- 淇濆瓨鏂瑰悜锛岀敤浜?OnProjectileHit
        data.dir_x = dir.x
        data.dir_y = dir.y
        data.dir_z = dir.z

    data.prev_x = pos.x

function projectile_base:OnProjectileHit_ExtraData(target, pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not data then return end

    local dummy = EntIndexToHScript(data.dummy_entindex or -1)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return end

    local hit_target = nil

    if target and target:IsAlive() then
        hit_target = target
    end

    if not hit_target then
        return true
    end

    dummy:PerformAttack(
        hit_target,
        true,  -- bUseCastAttackOrb
        true,  -- bProcessProcs
        true,  -- bSkipCooldown
        false, -- bIgnoreInvis
        false, -- bUseProjectile (涓嶇敤鍗曚綅鏀诲嚮寮归亾)
        false, -- bFakeAttack
        true   -- bNeverMiss
    )

    return true
end

return projectile_base

    if not PlayerStats or not PlayerStats:GetDisplay(pid) then

    local cache

**Analyzing multi-projectile damage handling**

I’m working through how multiple projectiles from the same dummy unit can have distinct damage and behaviors, focusing on modifying autocast dummy modifiers and damage filters. It’s tricky since damage filters see only the attacker and inflictor but need to distinguish projectiles. I’m exploring using multiple modifiers per dummy or storing projectile-specific data in ExtraData and matching via inflictor or custom keys to route damage properly. There’s a lot to untangle around how projectiles relate to abilities and how hits apply damage with tracking projectiles and dummy attacks—so I’m piecing this together carefully!

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if not profile then

    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then

    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)

    if profile.behavior == \"Self\" then

            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),

    end

    local origin = self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()

    local pos = nil

            self.owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return interval
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end

    self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)

            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),

            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })

    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)

    if profile.behavior == "Self" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })

        return interval
    end

    local origin = self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return interval
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        self:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(profile, enemy)
        return interval
    end

    self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
    self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)

    if profile.behavior == "Position" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end

    return interval

    end

**Analyzing modifier loading order and initialization**

I’m working through the complex loading sequence of item scripts and modifiers to identify why the `modifier_item_stats:OnCreated` function isn’t firing and why the modifier handle appears null. It seems the root cause is that `LinkLuaModifier` for `modifier_item_stats` might be registered too late or not at all in certain item scripts, so the Lua modifier isn’t properly linked when `AddNewModifier` is called. To fix this, I’m considering moving `LinkLuaModifier("modifier_item_stats", ...)` to the top of `item_base.lua` so it’s always registered before any modifier instances get added. This should ensure the modifier class is properly loaded and eliminate the missing `OnCreated` logs and null handles observed otherwise. I’ll keep debug logs to verify the fix.

SELECTION_VERSION = "1.00"

--[[
    Lua-controlled Selection Library by Noya
    
    Installation:
    - "require" this file inside your code in order to add the new API functions to the PlayerResource global
    - Additionally, ensure your game scripts custom_net_tables.txt has a "selection" entry
    - Finally, ensure that you have the following files correctly added and included in your panorama content folder
        selection.xml, and include line on custom_ui_manifest.xml, on layout/custom_game/ folder
        selection folder containing selection.js and selection_filter.js, on /scripts/ folder

    Usage:
    - Functions with unit_args can recieve an Entity Index, a NPC Handle, or a table of each type.
    - Functions with unit can recieve an Entity Index or NPC Handle

    * Create a new selection for the player
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)

    * Add units to the current selection of the player
        PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Remove units by index from the player selection group
        PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Returns the list of units by entity index that are selected by the player
        PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)

    * Deselect everything, selecting the main hero (which can be redirected to another entity)
        PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)

    * Get the index of the first selected unit of the player
        PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    
    * Check if a unit is selected or not by a player, returns bool
        PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit_args)

    * Force a refresh of the current selection on all players, useful after abilities are removed
        PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    
    * Redirects the selection of the main hero to another entity of choice
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    
    * Redirects the selection of any entity to another entity of choice
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)

    * Use -1 to reset to default
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, -1)
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(-1)

    Notes:
    - Enemy units that you don't control can't be added to the selection group of a player
    - This library requires "libraries/timers.lua" to be present in your vscripts directory.

--]]

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_new", {entities = entities})
    end
end 

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_add", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_remove", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_reset", {})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    return Selection.entities[playerID] or {}
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID) 
    return selectedEntities and selectedEntities["0"]
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then return false end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if not entIndex then return false end
    
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    for _,v in pairs(selectedEntities) do
        if v==entIndex then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        FireGameEvent("dota_player_update_selected_unit", {})
    end)
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then unit = -1 end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or unit:GetEntityIndex()
    local hero = self:GetSelectedHeroEntity(playerID)
    if hero then
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)
    end
end

function CDOTA_BaseNPC:SetSelectionOverride(reselect_unit)
    local unit = self
    local reselectIndex = type(reselect_unit)=="number" and reselect_unit or reselect_unit:GetEntityIndex()

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("selection", tostring(unit:GetEntityIndex()), {entity = reselectIndex})
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal
------------------------------------------------------------------------

require('libraries/timers')

if not Selection then
    Selection = class({})
end

function Selection:Init()
    Selection.entities = {} --Stores the selected entities of each playerID
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("selection_update", Dynamic_Wrap(Selection, 'OnUpdate'))
end

function Selection:OnUpdate(event)
    local playerID = event.PlayerID
    Selection.entities[playerID] = event.entities

    if Selection.ignore_next and Selection.ignore_next[playerID] then
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = nil
        return
    end

    if not Shop1Managers or not Shop1Managers[playerID] then
        return
    end

    local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
    local entities = event.entities or {}
    local ent = entities[1] or entities["0"]
    if not ent then
        for _, v in pairs(entities) do
            ent = v
            break
        end
    end
    if not ent then return end

    local unit = EntIndexToHScript(ent)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then return end

    if mgr.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager] Selection update", playerID, "ent", ent, unit:GetUnitName())
    end

    local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit)
    if not slot or not data then
        if not Selection.last_dummy then Selection.last_dummy = {} end
        Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = nil
        return
    end

    Selection.last_dummy = Selection.last_dummy or {}
    local last = Selection.last_dummy[playerID]
    Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = { slot = slot, ent = ent }

    if last and last.slot and last.slot ~= slot then
        if mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(last.slot, slot, slot, false) then
            Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = nil
            Selection.ignore_next = Selection.ignore_next or {}
            Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = true
            PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)
        else
            local lastUnit = EntIndexToHScript(last.ent)
            if lastUnit and not lastUnit:IsNull() then
                mgr:HandleDummyDrag(lastUnit, unit:GetAbsOrigin(), true)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Internal function to build an entity index list out of various inputs
function Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
    local entities = {}
    if type(unit_args)=="number" then
        table.insert(entities, unit_args) -- Entity Index
    -- Check contents of the table
    elseif type(unit_args)=="table" then
        if unit_args.IsCreature then
            table.insert(entities, unit_args:GetEntityIndex()) -- NPC Handle
        else
            for _,arg in pairs(unit_args) do
                -- Table of entity index values
                if type(arg)=="number" then
                    table.insert(entities, arg)
                -- Table of npc handles
                elseif type(arg)=="table" then
                    if arg.IsCreature then
                        table.insert(entities, arg:GetEntityIndex())
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return entities
end

if not Selection.entities then Selection:Init() end
